summary: Comprehensive frontend UI redesign testing on Coco AI (mobile 390x844 and desktop 1440x800) covering Live Signals, Injector, Future Signals market pickers and setup/dock, mobile bottom-nav More & Analyzer sheets. Nearly every requested test passes; only failure is that the sheet backdrop is NOT blurred in the production build (computed backdrop-filter = 'none' even though source coco.css defines blur(16px)).

ui_bugs.issue: Requested feature — More sheet AND Analyzer sheet backdrops must apply backdrop-filter: blur(...). getComputedStyle(.coco-sheet-backdrop).backdropFilter returns 'none' in the running production build (both sheets). The single CSS rule reaching the browser is only '.coco-sheet-backdrop { background: rgba(7,4,26,0.6); transition:...; animation:... }' with NO backdrop-filter / -webkit-backdrop-filter declaration, even though /app/frontend/app/coco.css lines 492-498 do include backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(130%). Suggests the production CSS build (Next.js / lightningcss / Tailwind v4) is dropping those declarations. Repro: login → mobile 390x844 → click bottom-nav-more (or bottom-nav-analyzer) → evaluate getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.coco-sheet-backdrop')).backdropFilter → 'none'. Fix: either move the property under a supports rule, add it inline via a Tailwind class (backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150) on the backdrop div in coco-bottom-nav.tsx line 138, or verify next.config / postcss isn't stripping unknown properties. Rebuild required.

issues: 30+ console CORS errors from https://flagcdn.com/*.svg (No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header). Flag icons fetched via fetch() are blocked; use plain or a CORS-friendly host. Non-blocking but noisy.

action_items: Fix backdrop-filter blur on .coco-sheet-backdrop in the production build (More & Analyzer sheets). Recommended: add Tailwind classes 'backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150' to the backdrop div in /app/frontend/components/coco/coco-bottom-nav.tsx (line 138) so Tailwind emits the property, then `yarn build` and restart supervisor. Verify with getComputedStyle after fix.
(Minor) Switch flag icons from fetch() to (or self-host) to eliminate flagcdn CORS console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: future-signals-view.tsx uses two spans (sm:hidden / hidden sm:inline) for the Generate button label — this is fine visually but Playwright text_content() returns concatenated text 'Generate 5Generate 5 Future Signals'. Consider a single dynamic label to avoid confusing DOM/testing tools.
Flag icons on all three pickers are fetched cross-origin without CORS mode, causing repeated failed fetches on every render.

rca of the issue: Production Next.js build (next start) is serving CSS in which the `backdrop-filter` / `-webkit-backdrop-filter` declarations inside the `.coco-sheet-backdrop` rule are missing. Source file /app/frontend/app/coco.css lines 494-495 contain them, so a CSS build/transform (likely Tailwind v4 / lightningcss / postcss config) is stripping them. Confirmed via document.styleSheets iteration returning only `.coco-sheet-backdrop { background:...; transition:...; animation:...; }`. Mitigation: add explicit Tailwind utilities on the backdrop element or ensure preserve of unknown properties; then rebuild.
